newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Small increase in demand seen.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Small increase in demand seen.

text.p: Demand for cash soymeal improved slightly over late last week, with buyers primarily booking supplies for immediate shipment, dealers said.

Basis values eased in the Southeast and U.S. Gulf export markets. In the Southeast, spring pastures were lessening the need for livestock feed, and in the export market the availability of lower-priced Brazilian soymeal reduced demand for U.S. soymeal, dealers said.
A smaller than expected crush last week encouraged buyers to step into the market a little quicker than they otherwise would have done, dealers said.

The drop in the crush prompted expectations that soymeal prices will increase. The National Oilseed Processors Association crush for the week ended March 19 was 28.121 million bushels vs 30.106 million the previous week.
